notes: the two «ح» branches meet on Hisham: «حدثنا هشام» (branch 1) and «عن هشام» (branch 2); the fuller «قال هشام بن عروة» is the same man written in full (rule 7), so the tail starts there and is written once for both
«- المعنى -» is an editor gloss and is left out; «زاد مسدد» is a wording addition, left out
